system.description:
Skill: Martial Arts

Exploit Type: Combat Exploit

Requirements: Undertaker Subclass

You channel pure brutality into a devastating strike. When you deal Lethal Attack damage, you may choose to forgo 1 or 2 Lethal Attack dice. If you forgo 1 Lethal Attack dice, the damaged creature must make a Strength saving throw, gaining 1 rank of Weakened and suffer disadvantage on their next attack roll before the beginning of your next turn on a failed save

If you forgo 2 Lethal Attack dice, the damaged creature must make a Strength saving throw, being knocked prone and being unable to take reactions on a failed save.
